sharedVariables.sensitiveHint: Values are never shown again, in logs or in history.

sharedVariables.deleteDescription: The variable and all its values are removed. This cannot be undone.

keyRule.exists: A variable with this key exists.

catalog.addHint: {{title}} — drag onto the canvas or click to add

description.action: Runs an action of this profile.
description.parallel: Runs the connected branches at the same time.
description.join: Waits for every incoming branch, then continues.
description.loop: Runs another workflow a fixed number of times.
description.call: Runs another workflow once with inputs and uses its outputs.
description.output: Sets this workflow's outputs for the node that calls it.
description.setVariable: Assigns variables of this run for the nodes after it.

inspector.label: Label
inspector.nodeIdHint: Used to refer to this node's outputs.

failure.title: On failure
failure.actionHint: A connected “On error” output always handles the failure.
failure.callHint: A connected “On error” output always handles the failure. Sub-workflows are not retried.
failure.timeoutCancellable: Default {{duration}}. Stops at once when the run is cancelled or the time is up.
failure.timeoutNotCancellable: Default {{duration}}. Cannot be interrupted: it finishes before a cancellation or timeout takes effect, and a late result is discarded.
failure.callTimeoutHint: Default {{duration}}. Cancelling the run or reaching the timeout stops the sub-workflow too.

condition.hint: Yes and No continue with different nodes; connect them on the canvas.

call.hint: Runs once, with this run's project context; this run waits for it.
call.noInputs: {{name}} declares no inputs. Inputs are declared in its workflow panel.
call.notSet: Not set; the workflow gets no value.
call.unknownInput: {{key}} is no longer an input of {{workflow}}.

output.none: This workflow declares no outputs. Declare them in the workflow panel (click the canvas background).
output.hint: The node that calls this workflow gets these values. When several Output nodes run, the one that finishes later wins.

variables.title: Variables
variables.none: This workflow declares no variables. Declare them in the workflow panel (click the canvas background).
variables.hint: Nodes after this one read the new values as “Variable · …”. Variables last for one run; a sub-workflow gets them only through its inputs.

projectScope.label: May change the active project
projectScope.application: When a run ends on another project, it becomes DeckPilot’s active project — unless the active project changed during the run.
projectScope.execution: Project selections stay in each run: they affect the nodes after them, never DeckPilot’s active project or other runs.
projectScope.atStart: Runs use the active project of the moment they start.

connection.self: a node cannot connect to itself
connection.intoStart: nothing can connect into the start node
connection.oneTarget: an output connects to one node; branch with a Parallel or Condition node
connection.oneIncoming: only a Join node can have several incoming connections
connection.cycle: this would create a cycle; use a Loop node to repeat

blocked.new: Save the workflow to run it
blocked.dirty: Save your changes to run the workflow
blocked.agent: The agent is not running. Start it in Settings › Agent
blocked.profile: Workflows run for the active profile. Make “{{profile}}” active to run this one

error.timeout: The node took longer than its timeout.
error.cancelled: The run was cancelled while the node ran.
error.mapping: An input could not be resolved from earlier outputs.
error.parallelContext: A context-changing action cannot run in a parallel branch.
error.loopFailed: A run of the looped workflow failed.
error.unavailable: The action or its module is not available.
error.transient: Transient: running it again, or a retry policy, may help.
error.permanent: Not transient: running it again will not help without a change.

details.title: Run details
details.waiting: Waiting for the first node to start.
details.empty: This run did not run any nodes.
details.choose: Choose a node on the timeline to see its retries, failure and outputs.

retries.title: Retries
retries.historyOnly: Run history keeps only the final attempt; earlier attempts and their waits are shown only while a run is watched live.

outputs.title: Outputs
outputs.declaredOnly: Only declared outputs are shown; sensitive outputs reach later nodes but are never kept.

history.title: Runs
history.clearTitle: Clear the run history of this workflow?
history.clearDescription: Finished runs are deleted. Running workflows are not affected.
history.problem: Earlier runs could not be loaded: {{problem}} They load again when the agent reconnects.
history.empty: No runs yet. Runs started here, from a Stream Deck or while the app was closed appear here.

report.title: Run
report.declaredOnly: Only outputs the action declares are recorded.

toast.clearFailed: The run history was not cleared

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: Start this workflow on a schedule or when something happens, while DeckPilot is unlocked and this profile is active. A run is skipped while the previous one still runs; missed times are not made up.

mapping.label: Mapping
mapping.defaultPlaceholder: Default when the output is missing
mapping.emptyParts: Add text and outputs to compose the value.

fit.lines: Each line of the value becomes one item; nothing is split on spaces.
fit.pairs: Each line must be a name and a value separated by “{{separator}}”.
fit.credential: The value must be the name of a credential stored on this computer.
fit.integer: The value must be a whole number when the node runs.
fit.boolean: The value must be “true” or “false” when the node runs.
fit.choice: The value must be one of: {{options}}.
fit.project: The value must be a project key of this profile.
fit.resource: Resources cannot come from earlier nodes.

problem.variableType: {{reference}} is a {{type}} value, the parameter expects {{expected}}
problem.defaultType: the default is a {{type}} value, the parameter expects {{expected}}
problem.notText: {{reference}} is a {{type}} value and cannot be part of text
problem.notBefore: “{{node}}” does not run before this node

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: Values for one run. Set variable nodes change them; later nodes read them as “Variable · …”.
variables.label: Variable label

problem.unknown: “{{reference}}” is not a reference; use shared.…, system.…, workflow.… or steps.…

interface.outputsDescription: Values this workflow returns to a Sub-workflow node; Output nodes set them.
